extraction_notes: Identity verified: the supplied PDF identifies PMBT3904 as a Nexperia 40 V, 200 mA NPN switching transistor; the exact inventory MPN is PMBT3904,215.
Pages 1 through 10 were examined. The revision table identifies this product data sheet as PMBT3904 v.5, released 20240216.

Figures 1 through 5 were digitized from the supplied PDF vector plot paths without interpolation. Axis scale, SI units, temperature, bias, and typical-value semantics are preserved in each curve record.
The electrical-characteristics table gives hFE minimums at IC = 0.1 mA, 1 mA, 10 mA, 50 mA, and 100 mA, plus a maximum at IC = 10 mA. Guaranteed minimum and maximum semantics are preserved.

The electrical-characteristics table gives VCEsat maximums of 200 mV at IC = 10 mA, IB = 1 mA and 300 mV at IC = 50 mA, IB = 5 mA; VBEsat is 650 mV minimum and 850 mV maximum at 10 mA/1 mA and 950 mV maximum at 50 mA/5 mA.
The strict schema has no slots for VCBO, VEBO, IC peak, power, thermal, leakage, timing, or other additional datasheet rows; VCEO is retained in the vceo slot.
